introHtml: Limelightent cooling sport towels offer superior moisture-wicking and cooling performance, ideal for outdoor events, sports teams, and corporate giveaways. Choose from styles like the Cooling Towel, Golf/Sports Towel, or Sport Terry Velour Towel with Dobby Hem. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a branded experience that stands out.
